- docs/INVENTORY.md:Scripts section | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: scripts/transcript_archive.sh is not listed in the Scripts section of docs/INVENTORY.md.
  WHY: The inventory parity gate enforces that every tracked scripts/* file appears in the inventory, so this blocks CI/merge.
- scripts/transcript_archive.sh:55-115 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The transcript archive helper’s failure signaling is broken, so archive failures are treated as success or only logged instead of reliably surfacing TRANSCRIPT_ARCHIVE_FAIL.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on exact phrasing (blocker vs major vs nit), but they all pointed to the same dead/ineffective failure path in the shell/Python wrapper.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:32-41 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `source scripts/transcript_archive.sh` is unguarded under `set -euo pipefail`, so helper source failures can abort the poller instead of failing open.
  WHY: The reviewer set consistently reported that a parse/source error in the optional helper kills the phase unless the source is wrapped in a fail-open guard.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:40-48 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `source "${_validate_script_dir}/transcript_archive.sh"` is unguarded under `set -euo pipefail`, so helper source failures can abort validation instead of failing open.
  WHY: All reviewers who mentioned it described the same blocking source-time failure mode and recommended a `|| true`/`2>/dev/null || true` guard.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:45-50 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `source "${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR}/transcript_archive.sh"` is unguarded under `set -euo pipefail`, so helper source failures can abort the editor phase instead of failing open.
  WHY: The same optional-helper source issue appears here as in the other two entrypoints, with the same runtime abort behavior on source-time errors.
- agents.md:534-543 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: TRANSCRIPT_ARCHIVE_FAIL appears in both the prose prefix list and the LOG_PREFIX.name registry block, which reviewers flagged as duplicate-looking documentation.
  WHY: One reviewer said this is intentional because of the file’s two-list contract, while others called it a duplication, so this remains a low-severity disagreement.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:417-490 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new identity-reinject/temp-file handling can still lose the injected block or leave temp files behind on non-exec exit paths.
  WHY: The reviewer pointed to branches that still read the original PROMPT_FILE or only clean up on the exec path, so the new restore logic is not robust on all render exits.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Fail open on archive I/O problems and emit TRANSCRIPT_ARCHIVE_FAIL instead of failing the host phase."
  expected_change_site: scripts/transcript_archive.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The Python `fail()` path raises `SystemExit(1)` while the shell wrapper uses `if ! python3 ... then return 0 fi`, so the archive-failure branch is not a reliable fail-open contract.
- requirement: "Fail open on archive I/O problems and emit TRANSCRIPT_ARCHIVE_FAIL instead of failing the host phase."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, scripts/validate_process.sh, scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The `source` commands for `transcript_archive.sh` in these three files lack `|| true` / `2>/dev/null || true` guards under `set -euo pipefail`, so source-time failures still abort the host phases.
- requirement: "Add scripts/transcript_archive.sh"
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  EVIDENCE: `scripts/transcript_archive.sh` is not listed in the Scripts section of docs/INVENTORY.md, so the inventory parity check still fails.
- requirement: "Add tests/test_transcript_archive.sh and tests/test_header_render.sh."
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The new `scripts/transcript_archive.sh` file is absent from the Scripts inventory in docs/INVENTORY.md, so the deliverables are not fully reflected in the inventory surface.
- requirement: "Add tests/test_transcript_archive.sh and tests/test_header_render.sh."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_transcript_archive.sh + .github/workflows/ci.yml
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The new test suite does not exercise the unreachable `SystemExit(1)` path or real I/O failure cases, so the fail-open contract is not actually verified.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
